title: Skill-Aware Data Selection and Fine-Tuning for Data-Efficient Reasoning Distillation
authors_zh: Lechen Zhang, Yunxiang Zhang, Wei Hu, Lu Wang
paper_type_zh: 以技能为中心的推理数据选择与蒸馏研究
best_for_zh: 从结构化推理教师语料构建学生自适应子集的读者。
one_line: Skill-aware distillation samples teacher traces for the student’s weak skills and adds full skill chains to the SFT target.
技能感知蒸馏按学生薄弱技能抽取教师轨迹，并把完整技能链加入监督微调目标。
why: It makes the relationship between a reasoning record, a student weakness profile, and the SFT consumer explicit.
inclusion_reason: It changes which teacher reasoning records and explicit skill structures are consumed by student SFT based on student-specific weaknesses.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Reasoning distillation often fine-tunes a smaller student on a large pool of teacher-generated question-answer traces. Treating every trace as equally useful wastes the limited training budget: a student may repeatedly see skills it already solves while remaining weak on a few atomic operations. Selecting a question as one indivisible unit also hides that one mathematical solution can require several linked skills.

This paper asks how a distillation corpus can be selected for the current weaknesses of a particular student model. The training record is a math question, a teacher solution, and a path of skills attributed to that question in a hierarchy. The decision is both which records enter a 1,000-example SFT subset and whether the student sees the skill path before the solution; it is not a claim that the hierarchy itself is a universal mathematical ontology.

推理蒸馏常在大量教师生成的问题—答案轨迹池上微调较小学生。把每条轨迹都当作同样有用会浪费有限训练预算：学生可能反复看到已经会的技能，却仍在少数原子操作上薄弱。把问题作为不可分割单位选择，也掩盖了一道数学解答可能需要多个相连技能这一事实。

本文追问怎样针对某个学生模型当前的弱点选择蒸馏语料。训练记录是数学问题、教师解答，以及在层次结构中归因给该问题的技能路径。决策既包括哪些记录进入 1,000 例的监督微调子集，也包括学生是否在解答前看到技能路径；它不声称该层次本身是普遍的数学本体。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The framework treats the student's per-skill accuracy as a demand signal. It maps each candidate solution from a 100K teacher corpus to one or more root-to-leaf chains in a predefined skill tree, evaluates the student on those leaf skills, and samples examples more often when their skills have lower accuracy. The selection target is therefore model-relative: a geometry-strong student should not receive the same mixture as a student weak in geometry.

The selected record is also structurally augmented. Before the teacher solution, skill-aware SFT prepends the ordered chains needed for the problem, such as mathematics to probability to Bayes' theorem. The paper's hypothesis is that this makes latent dependencies explicit instead of asking the model to infer skill organization only from question-answer pairs. Selection focuses the training budget, while the augmented chain changes what the chosen record asks the student to model.

该框架将学生逐技能准确率视为需求信号。它把 100K 教师语料中的每个候选解答映射到预定义技能树中的一个或多个根到叶路径，在这些叶技能上评估学生，并在技能准确率较低时更频繁地抽取样本。因此选择目标与模型相关：几何能力强的学生不应与几何能力弱的学生接收相同混合。

被选择的记录还会被结构化增广。教师解答前，技能感知监督微调写入解决问题所需的有序技能链，例如从数学到概率再到贝叶斯定理。论文的假设是，这使潜在依赖关系显式化，而不是只要求模型从问题—答案对推断技能组织。选择聚焦训练预算，增广技能链则改变所选记录要求学生建模的内容。

title: Method
方法
html:
A Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct attributor traverses the Instruct-SkillMix tree top down for every candidate, repeatedly choosing relevant child skills until reaching leaves. The paper then evaluates the student over the 100K pool and computes leaf-skill accuracy. A skill's sampling probability is inversely proportional to that accuracy, capped to prevent a near-zero score from dominating; 1,000 examples are sampled from the resulting distribution. The authors manually inspect about 100 attributed pairs and report no observed missing or mislabeled skills, but this is a limited spot check rather than a full annotation audit.

For skill-aware SFT, the complete ordered chain is inserted before each reference solution. The main experiments use 100K unique OpenMathReasoning question-answer pairs, the predefined Instruct-SkillMix taxonomy, Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B students, and five SFT epochs. They compare full-pool, random, and skill-based 1K subsets with or without the skill-chain augmentation, then evaluate Avg@8 on AMC23, AIME 2024, AIME 2025, MATH Level 5, and OlympiadBench. The release states that code and the constructed data are available from the official repository.

Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 归因器对每个候选在 Instruct-SkillMix 树上自顶向下遍历，反复选择相关子技能直到叶节点。论文随后在 100K 池上评估学生并计算叶技能准确率。一个技能的抽样概率与该准确率成反比，并设上限以防接近零的分数主导；从结果分布中抽取 1,000 个例子。作者人工检查约 100 个归因对，报告未观察到缺失或错误标记技能，但这只是有限抽查，而非完整标注审计。

对于技能感知监督微调，完整有序链被插入每条参考解答之前。主实验使用 100K 条独特 OpenMathReasoning 问题—答案对、预定义 Instruct-SkillMix 分类法、Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 学生模型，并训练五个周期。它比较带或不带技能链增广的全池、随机和基于技能的 1K 子集，再在 AMC23、AIME 2024、AIME 2025、MATH Level 5 和 OlympiadBench 上评估 Avg@8。发布说明代码和构造数据可从官方仓库获取。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The strongest reported comparison keeps the budget fixed at 1,000 records. For Qwen3-4B, random standard SFT averages 66.8, whereas skill-based selection plus skill-aware SFT reaches 68.4; for Qwen3-8B, the corresponding values are 68.1 and 69.5. Fine-tuning on all 100K records performs worse than the base models in both blocks, at 58.1 and 58.5 respectively, so the paper's evidence is not merely that added instructions help but that a targeted subset can avoid the full-pool degradation.

The ablation shows that selection and augmentation each contribute: skill-based selection alone reaches 67.3 and 68.5, while random skill-aware SFT reaches 67.6 and 69.4 for the two Qwen students. A further DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B test reaches 53.0 with the combined method versus 52.0 for random standard SFT. The paper reports that gains concentrate on emphasized weak skills and that the full hierarchy beats root-only or leaf-only prompts. These results support the specified math taxonomy and students; they do not establish equally reliable skill attribution or weak-skill estimation in non-math domains.

最强的报告比较固定预算为 1,000 条记录。对于 Qwen3-4B，随机标准监督微调平均为 66.8，而基于技能选择加技能感知监督微调达到 68.4；对于 Qwen3-8B，对应数值为 68.1 和 69.5。在两个区块中，使用全部 100K 记录微调的表现都差于基础模型，分别为 58.1 和 58.5，因此论文的证据不只是增加指令有帮助，而是目标子集能避免全池退化。

消融显示选择和增广均有贡献：单独基于技能选择对两个 Qwen 学生达到 67.3 和 68.5，而随机技能感知监督微调达到 67.6 和 69.4。进一步的 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B 测试中，组合方法达到 53.0，随机标准监督微调为 52.0。论文报告收益集中于被强调的弱技能，且完整层级优于仅根或仅叶提示。这些结果支持指定的数学分类法和学生模型；它们不证明非数学领域中技能归因或弱技能估计同样可靠。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Existing efficient-distillation methods can choose a small high-quality set, but often score a problem as one unit or use a fixed selection independent of the student. This work turns the record into a multi-skill object and bases sampling on the student's measured competence at the leaves. It also distinguishes selecting records from training on them: the skill chain is retained as explicit supervision rather than used only as an offline filter.

The novelty is the connection between a hierarchical attribution, a student-specific weakness profile, and a structured SFT target. It is not simply oversampling difficult questions. The full-chain ablation matters because the authors claim hierarchy carries useful dependencies beyond a flat list, while the skill-accuracy plot matters because it tests whether more sampling is actually directed to—and improves—the intended weak areas.

既有效率蒸馏方法可以选择小型高质量集合，却常把问题作为一个单位打分，或使用与学生无关的固定选择。该工作把记录变成多技能对象，并基于学生在叶节点测得的能力抽样。它还区分选择记录和在记录上训练：技能链被保留为显式监督，而不是只作离线过滤器。

新意在于连接层次归因、学生特定弱点画像和结构化监督微调目标。它不只是过采样困难问题。完整链消融很重要，因为作者主张层次携带平面列表之外的有用依赖；逐技能准确率图也很重要，因为它检验更多抽样是否真的指向并改善预期的薄弱区域。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The approach relies on an existing skill tree that may not match the student's own decomposition of reasoning, and a per-skill accuracy estimated from limited examples can be noisy. One-time attribution of the 100K pool takes about 200 GPU hours according to the paper, so the cost is amortizable but not free. The principal experiments cover mathematics and two Qwen scales, with an additional distilled Llama model; broader domains and larger students remain unverified. Because weak-skill sampling can emphasize errors in the attribution or evaluation profile, reuse should audit the taxonomy, label quality, coverage, and whether short skill labels leak benchmark-specific structure.

该方法依赖已有技能树，而它可能不符合学生自身的推理分解；从有限例子估计的逐技能准确率也可能有噪声。论文称 100K 池的一次归因约需 200 GPU 小时，因此成本可摊销但并非免费。主要实验覆盖数学和两个 Qwen 规模，另加一个蒸馏 Llama 模型；更广领域和更大规模学生仍未验证。由于弱技能抽样可能放大归因或评测画像中的错误，复用应审计分类法、标签质量、覆盖面，以及简短技能标签是否泄漏了基准特定结构。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: Use this framework when a teacher corpus can be mapped to an interpretable skill taxonomy and the student can be evaluated at the corresponding leaves before SFT. Preserve the exact taxonomy version, attribution model and prompt, per-skill evaluation set, accuracy estimates, capped sampling formula, selected record identifiers, and the formatting of inserted skill chains. Compare random and full-pool SFT under the same 1K budget, report per-skill as well as aggregate results, and avoid treating an inferred low score as a stable weakness without repeated or uncertainty-aware measurement.
当教师语料可映射到可解释技能分类法，且学生可在对应叶节点上于监督微调前被评估时，可使用该框架。应保留精确分类法版本、归因模型和提示、逐技能评测集、准确率估计、带上限抽样公式、所选记录标识以及插入技能链的格式。应在相同 1K 预算下比较随机和全池监督微调，报告逐技能和聚合结果，并避免在没有重复或不确定性感知测量时把推断的低分数当作稳定弱点。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: The Card's central object is not just a selected question but a question connected to a hierarchy and to a particular student's competence profile. That distinction explains why the same 100K pool can yield different 1K mixtures for different students. The full-data failure is a useful caution: more teacher traces can harm a strong reasoning model if they are redundant or misallocated. When reproducing, first validate the attribution and per-skill measurement, then test whether explicit chains improve reasoning rather than merely making the output imitate the labels.
本卡的中心对象不只是被选择的问题，而是连接到层次结构和特定学生能力画像的问题。这一区别说明为何同一 100K 池能为不同学生产生不同 1K 混合。全数据失败是有用警告：如果教师轨迹冗余或分配失当，更多轨迹会伤害强推理模型。复现时，应先验证归因和逐技能测量，再检验显式技能链是否改善推理，而不只是让输出模仿标签。
